cases.name: vbat-mean
cases.meaning: Cycle-average positive DC loads; ideal capacitor mean currents omitted under saved pi-mean-policy.json.

cases.name: vbat-envelope
cases.meaning: Noncoincident stress screen: every pad receives its maximum absolute settled current simultaneously. Not an actual instant, not actual cell peak, not a waveform-average Joule loss.

cases.name: gnd-mean-reversed
cases.meaning: Cycle-average positive DC loads; ideal capacitor mean currents omitted under saved pi-mean-policy.json. GND currents reversed at a mathematical 3 V reference; physical ground rise is the solved drop magnitude.

cases.name: gnd-envelope-reversed
cases.meaning: Noncoincident stress screen: every pad receives its maximum absolute settled current simultaneously. Not an actual instant, not actual cell peak, not a waveform-average Joule loss. Ground currents reversed at a mathematical 3 V reference for drop/loss magnitudes.

limitations: Fixed-temperature 2.5D DC conduction on saved copper; no source-droop, contact-resistance or electrochemical solve.
Cycle-average load conduction loss is not the actual time-average I-squared-R loss of switching currents.
Per-pad absolute-current envelope is a noncoincident stress case, not the observed cell peak.
GND fields use reversed currents at a shifted mathematical 3 V reference. Interpret voltage-drop magnitudes as physical ground rise.
Physical op-amp ground currents include the explicit hidden-global-ground assignment from the vendor family model. Raw model discrepancies remain in power-budget.json.
Local current-density peaks require a separate convergence result and do not establish ampacity or hardware qualification.
